newsitem.title: USA: CSX says confident will prevail in merger.
newsitem.headline: CSX says confident will prevail in merger.

text.p: CSX Corp said it is confident it will prevail in its planned $9.3 billion merger with Conrail Inc even though Conrail shareholders apparently defeated a key provision in the deal.
"We have no intention of amending or altering our merger agreement in any way in light of this apparent vote," CSX chairman John Snow said on Friday.
He said managements of CSX and Conrail are preparing to present the merger to the federal Surface Transportation Board in March.

"The apparent 'no' vote procured by Norfolk Southern simply postpones the eventual completion of our strategic merger of equals and delays the ability of Conrail's shareholders to receive the full consideration that will be provided by the CSX-Conrail transaction," CSX said.

CSX also noted that Conrail's board has never expressed an interest in entering into merger negotiations with Norfolk Southern at the end of the two-year period that prohibits merger talks with other companies.
CSX also said that it and Conrail will not meet with Norfolk Southern until after the two companies have rebuffed Norfolk's challenges to the merger.
